title: Automotive
summary: Our core sector since 2004 — seating structures, footrest assemblies, brackets and reinforcements for OEMs and Tier-1 suppliers.
intro: Automotive is not one of the sectors we serve; it is the sector we were built for. Every process, tolerance discipline and inspection routine in the business was shaped by two decades of supplying Indian automotive OEMs and Tier-1 manufacturers.
body: We currently supply eight-plus OEM and Tier-1 partners across the Indian automotive supply chain, most of them repeat, multi-year customers. Current production includes seat assemblies for utility-vehicle programmes, two-wheeler footrest assemblies in matched RH/LH pairs, seat structure components, and coated and tubular parts.

What automotive work demands is not exotic capability — it is consistency under call-off pressure. Parts that measure the same in week forty as in week one, delivered against a schedule that does not move, with inspection records that survive an audit. That is what our 100% inspection commitment, in-house tool room and 144 kVA of standby power exist to protect.

It also means we understand the commercial reality: PPAP expectations, drawing revisions arriving mid-programme, and the fact that a line stoppage costs a customer more in an hour than our entire order value. We plan accordingly.
